split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before stress family name, source-surface row, manifest case id, workflow label, generated artifact, evidence-log row, migration-only row, compatibility row, or retired-surface claim
split_policy.positive_rule: stress fixtures can cite canonical Objective-C 3 behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners; source-surface rows, manifest case ids, workflow labels, replay outputs, and provenance rows are not behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: stress source-surface rows, family coverage goals, source paths, manifest rows, case ids, fixture group names, surface contract labels, workflow commands, replay artifacts, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, and migration-only rows are provenance until a phase owner claims behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: compatibility-looking, fallback-looking, shim-looking, old-mode, migration-only, generated-only, evidence-log, unsupported-feature, and alternate acceptance path stress cases are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.generated_artifact_rule: tmp stress artifacts, replay outputs, module.ll outputs, module.manifest.json outputs, generated-only rows, and evidence-log rows are machine-owned evidence and cannot create positive behavior support

owner_splits.boundary: parser corpus and grammar recovery stress inputs
semantic diagnostics, type flow, effects, and unsupported feature stress inputs
lowering and ABI handoff stress inputs
IR replay, module artifact, manifest, and emission stress inputs
runtime dispatch, package loading, replay, and live runtime stress inputs
compile-link-run, mixed-module differential, and replay-backed end-to-end stress inputs
stress fallback, shim, old-mode, migration, generated-only, evidence-log, compatibility, unsupported, strict-error, and alternate acceptance claims
stress source-surface rows, manifest rows, workflow labels, replay artifacts, generated evidence, and owner split routing metadata
